cool.note: Cool surcharge added on top of base rate. Refrigerated 2-10°C or frozen -15°C, same price. Service unavailable above 140-size.

weight_over_30kg.note: Per-package surcharge added when actual weight exceeds 30kg, applied only on Large-size service (170-260). +¥270 for 30<w≤40, +¥540 for 40<w≤50.

branch_dropoff_discount.note: Drop-off at Sagawa branch reduces fare by ¥100/item. Excludes contract rates and COD shipments.

remote_island.note: 中継料 (transit fee) applies for some remote islands beyond posted rate matrix; varies by destination.

fuel.note: Domestic Sagawa parcel has no separate fuel surcharge — already included in base rate. International parcel is 18% as of 2024-10.
